title: FUJIFILM Motion Picture Film (product manual, characteristic curves only)

stocks.name: FUJICOLOR ETERNA 250 8553 / 8653

meta.exposure: 3200K light source, 1/50 s, Fuji Filter SC-41

notes: curves read directly from the PDF vector paths, no tracing
the manual prints the characteristic curves only (no spectral sensitivity or dye density plots)
characteristic curves printed against camera stops (-6..+6), converted to relative log H

borrow.why: tungsten EI 250 Fujifilm cine negative with its own data sheet, the stock ETERNA 250 replaced

recipe.name: Fujifilm Eterna 250 (KB-1101E)
estimates: spectral sensitivities and dye densities (minimum and mid-scale) are not in the manual: borrowed from fujifilm_f250_kb914e (tungsten EI 250 Fujifilm cine negative with its own data sheet, the stock ETERNA 250 replaced)
the characteristic curves are printed against camera stops: converted to relative log H (1 stop = 0.30103), the absolute exposure scale comes from the builder's speed-point anchoring
spectral sensitivity on a relative log scale (one log unit = the interval marked '1.0'), absolute level from the builder's mid-grey anchoring
sensitivity tails beyond the printed curves
base+fog and mid-scale dye densities read from the sheet, individual CMY dyes reconstructed by the builder (not printed)
dye densities outside the printed 400-700 nm
print stock: KODAK VISION 2383 (the shipped cine print profile; FUJIFILM ETERNA-CP 3513/3514 is not in the repository)
interlayer DIR coupler strength (not on any data sheet; runtime default for negatives)
